EnhanceSimpleDesc: Increases the level of Snap Command and summons Automaton Beetle to offset DMG for on-field ally character.
EnhanceDesc:
Increases the level of Snap Command to additionally increase the DMG dealt by all allies.
Summons "Automaton Beetle." When any on-field ally character is attacked, consumes 1 Charge to offset this instance of DMG for them. Starts with <unbreak>1</unbreak> Charge. Snap Command can replenish <unbreak>1</unbreak> point(s), up to a maximum of replenishing <unbreak>2</unbreak> time(s) in this battle.

EnhanceSimpleDesc: Increases the level of Snap Command and summons an Automaton Hound to heal and rescue on-field ally characters.
EnhanceDesc:
Increases the level of Snap Command to additionally increase DMG dealt by all allies.
Summons "Automaton Hound," which has <unbreak>200</unbreak> SPD. When taking action, restores HP for all on-field allies equal to <unbreak>20%</unbreak> of their Max HP.
When the HP of any on-field ally character falls below <unbreak>50%</unbreak>, consumes 1 Charge to advance this unit's action by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. Starts with <unbreak>1</unbreak> Charge. Snap Command replenishes <unbreak>1</unbreak> Charge, up to a max of replenishing <unbreak>2</unbreak> time(s) in this battle.

EnhanceSimpleDesc: Increases the level of Snap Command and summons "Fast Hand" and "Slow Hand" to deal True DMG against enemies.
EnhanceDesc:
Increases the level of Snap Command to additionally increase DMG dealt by all allies.
Summons "Fast Hand" and "Slow Hand." "Fast Hand" immediately takes action, and "Slow Hand" takes action at <unbreak>200</unbreak> SPD. Self-destructs when taking action to deal True DMG equal to <unbreak>5%</unbreak> of the unit's Max HP to one random enemy. Can be summoned again by Snap Command. A maximum of <unbreak>4</unbreak> "Slow Hands" can exist. If the limit is exceeded when summoned, it immediately takes action.

EnhanceDesc: Svarog's SPD increases by <unbreak>30%</unbreak>.

EnhanceSimpleDesc: When an on-field ally character's HP is low, Svarog triggers Snap Command and dispels Control states from all on-field allies. This can only be triggered 1 time per battle.
EnhanceDesc: When any on-field ally character's HP falls below <unbreak>30%</unbreak>, Svarog triggers Snap Command and dispels Control states from all on-field allies. This can only be triggered 1 time per battle.
